summary: Independent Bank Corp announced a $200 million stock buyback plan authorized by its Board effective April 30, 2026. Repurchases will commence after completion of the $10.5 million remaining under a July 2025 plan, with open-market and private transactions and Rule 10b5-1 plans. The program expires April 29, 2027, and may be modified or discontinued. No pricing details were provided beyond the aggregate authorization. The filing is an 8-K Item 8.01 Other Events. This is a routine capital return announcement; no special-situation activating events such as a tender offer or going-private transaction are involved.
